title: E6AP AZUL interaction with UBQLN1/2 in cells, condensates, and an AlphaFold-NMR integrated structure.
authors: Buel, Gwen R; Chen, Xiang; Myint, Wazo; Kayode, Olumide; Folimonova, Varvara; Cruz, Anthony; Skorupka, Katarzyna A; Matsuo, Hiroshi; Walters, Kylie J
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold2-Multimer与NMR实验，解析E6AP AZUL与UBQLN1/2 UBA的弱亲和瞬时互作结构，并揭示其在凝聚体中的招募机制，是IDR介导PPI机制建模的典型范例。
abstract: The E3 ligase E6AP/UBE3A has a dedicated binding site in the 26S proteasome provided by the RAZUL domain of substrate receptor hRpn10/S5a/PSMD4. Guided by RAZUL sequence similarity, we test and demonstrate here that the E6AP AZUL binds transiently to the UBA of proteasomal shuttle factor UBQLN1/2. Despite a weak binding affinity, E6AP AZUL is recruited to UBQLN2 biomolecular condensates in vitro and E6AP interacts with UBQLN1/2 in cellulo. Steady-state and transfer nuclear Overhauser effect (NOE) experiments indicate direct interaction of AZUL with UBQLN1 UBA. Intermolecular contacts identified by NOE spectroscopy (NOESY) data were combined with AlphaFold2-Multimer predictions to yield an AZUL:UBA model structure. We additionally identify an oligomerization domain directly adjacent to UBQLN1/2 UBA (UBA adjacent [UBAA]) that is alpha-helical and allosterically reconfigured by AZUL binding to UBA. These data lead to a model of E6AP recruitment to UBQLN1/2 by AZUL:UBA interaction and provide fundamental information on binding requirements for interactions in condensates and cells.
abstract_zh: E3连接酶E6AP/UBE3A在26S蛋白酶体中有一个专属结合位点，由底物受体hRpn10/S5a/PSMD4的RAZUL结构域提供。基于RAZUL序列相似性，我们在此测试并证明E6AP的AZUL结构域与蛋白酶体穿梭因子UBQLN1/2的UBA结构域发生瞬时结合。尽管结合亲和力较弱，E6AP AZUL在体外被招募至UBQLN2生物分子凝聚体中，且E6AP在细胞内与UBQLN1/2相互作用。稳态和转移核Overhauser效应（NOE）实验表明AZUL与UBQLN1 UBA直接相互作用。通过NOE光谱（NOESY）数据鉴定的分子间接触与AlphaFold2-Multimer预测相结合，生成了AZUL:UBA模型结构。我们还鉴定了一个直接邻近UBQLN1/2 UBA的寡聚化结构域（UBA邻近[UBAA]），该结构域呈α-螺旋构象，并因AZUL与UBA结合而经历变构重构。这些数据提出了E6AP通过AZUL:UBA相互作用被招募至UBQLN1/2的模型，并为凝聚体和细胞中相互作用的结合要求提供了基础信息。
